notes.title: Round 13 of the Beat the Gods Competition starts now!
notes.content:
We are back!
Round 13 of the community event "Beat the Gods" starts now! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24329565/6bdee58c9c67346ebea9906560b5e5f4c47ef4c0.png[/img]

[h1]The System[/h1]
[list]
[*]This week features 5 Maps. Set a time and try to beat the time of the gods!
[*]If you beat the gods on at least 3 maps, you will win this Round!
[*]Gods’ time is calculated by the average of each individual god’s time!
[*]For the “All Powerup Map”: The time for you to beat is calculated by the average of the top 3 of gods’ times.
[*]At the end of the round you will get points for every level you've played.
[*]The average time of the gods will be used as reference for a SRPR of 10,000.
[/list]
We decided to reward winners (beat 3 gods at least) and the the best player if no player beats the gods: 
[h1]Round 13 Prize Pool:
[/h1]
[h2]Gods are beaten:[/h2]
[list]
[*]1st: 75% ($45)
[*]2nd: 25% ($15)
[/list][h2]Gods are not beaten:[/h2]
[list]
[*]1st: 25% ($15)
[*]2nd: 0% ($0)
[/list]

[h1]Prize Pool: $60 USD[/h1]

[h1]Rules:
[/h1]
[list]
[*] Replays are locked.
[*] At the end of the week the replays and the times, as well as a spreadsheet with points will be released. No need to sign up, everyone can participate
[*] Gentle's Bounce is banned
[*] Subject to modification
[*] Macros and scripts are banned 
[*] Major evidence of cheating leads to disqualification and permanent ban from the competition
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Every former god is excluded from competition.
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Former cheaters are also banned from competing.
[/list]
[h1]Schedule:
[/h1]
[list]
[*] Start: August 17th 8pm CET
[*] End: August 24th 8pm CET
[/list]
[h1]Gods this Round:
[/h1]
Snail489, Klooger
ThyBreadKing, Mixtraa
Sev3n, Royal
sSolle, Royal

[h1]All Powerups[/h1]
Snail489, ThyBreadKing, Klooger, Sev3n, Royal, Mixtraa


[i]Disclaimer: Beat the Gods is a contest organized solely by our awesome community, and Pine Studio has nothing to do with it. \m/[/i]

notes.title: A new DLC and a free update are coming this fall!
notes.content:
To celebrate the biggest sale yet, we have a few good news to announce! 

The first and the most exciting is that we are working on a [b]FREE update[/b] and a [b]new DLC[/b]! Both are coming out [b]this fall[/b]! To name a few things that we plan to add to the game: 
[list]
[*] New floor with 11 new levels! 
[*] New powerup! 
[*] Two new modifiers. 
[*] A few long-awaited fixes. (you know what I'm talking about ;)) 
[*] New "League system".
[/list]
We have one more awesome surprise, but more on that in August! 

Btw, we are also working on a really cool project called [b]Escape Simulator[/b]. Check it out, and don't forget to wishlist! <3 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435790/Escape_Simulator/?utm_source=seum&utm_campaign=landing 

To new speedrunners: [b]have fun[/b]! \m/
Pine Studio team

notes.title: Season 7 starts today!
notes.content:
Dear speedrunners,

Time for the seventh season of speedrunning in the hell is at hand! 

[b]What's new[/b]
[list]
[*] Mutators - To kick off a new season, we (finally) added mutators for individual levels. To unlock mutators, you will have to finish it 100%.
[*] A few small fixes
[/list]Additionally, we are inviting you to share your ideas, thoughts, and suggestions on how to make SEUM an even greater experience for everyone. 
The rumor has it the gates of hell [i]might[/i] reopen once more, where monstrously good [b]SEUM 2[/b] is awaiting for new speedrunners!

https://forms.gle/SszWPDYckJKdEXwx9

Let’s burn hell to the ground!
Pine Studio

P.S.
DLC will be 50% off tomorrow! Check it out, it's cool! \m/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/713560/SEUM_The_Drunk_Side_of_the_Moon/

notes.title: New Season, BtG competition, and Summer Sale!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24329565/840c5a927173cb348bc9b0657f63109fadd94a0b.png[/img]
Speedrunners, 
it's finally time for [b]a new speedrunning season![/b] As always the best players from Season 3 will get their special place in the "Pit of Infamy" and will be remembered until the end of times.

[h1]Summer Sale[/h1]
During the Summer Sale [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/457210/SEUM_Speedrunners_from_Hell/]SEUM is 70% off[/url], the lowest price ever! Also, it's a great time to grab [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/713560/SEUM_The_Drunk_Side_of_the_Moon/]SEUM's DLC[/url] while it's 50% off!

[i]In other news:[/i]
[h1]Round 6 of Beat the Gods competition just started![/h1]
You can win this week, even if you don't own the DLC - and even win a copy of it!

[h1]Major System Changes:[/h1]
• We introduce a leaderboard for the competition. Even if you don’t win a round, you still can collect points and climb the leaderboard!
• Get medals and discord roles according to your achievements!
• Further ideas following
• Gods also will appear on the leaderboard having a disadvantage of not playing every week!

[h1]Round 6:[/h1]
1st Place: 10 € Paysafe card or Steam money
2nd Place: Seum: Drunk Side of the Moon DLC 
3rd Place: Seum: Drunk Side of the Moon DLC 

[h1]Schedule:[/h1]
• Maps: Created until June 19th.
• Gods: Setting their time on June 20th.
• Publishing: June 20th
• Competition ends on June 27th

More info at (un)official Discord server: https://discord.gg/YTYHpaF

\m/
Pine Studio Team

notes.title: SEUM Patch #3249
notes.content:
Here is the full changelog:

[h1]Bugs fixed:[/h1]
* Can't jump from spawnpoint anymore
* Snapback when spawning
* Wrong leaderboard labels on speedrun end screens
* Can't pick up something secret on Mac level select
* Burnt Waffle invincible bug
* Fixed levels which could not have been beaten in speedruns with mutators
* Removed floors that don't exist in DLC from UI
* Cutscenes and decorative torches on walls no longer ignore audio settings
* Incorrect level numbers for locked levels requirement
* 666% can now be achieved if DLC is not bought
* D16 - Ghost platforms in shadow world can be shot from normal world by using roar in the previous level
* Added more bugs to fix later

* Burnt Waffle
* Spirit Protector
* Parachute
* Faaaaal
* Waffle
* Burnt Waffle
* Hill
* Bunny Hopping
* Lab Rat
* Dolphin Dance

\m/
[i]Pine Studio[/i]

notes.title: DLC is out now! + Free Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24329565/db2684e472bf8a2662b911cf26512aabad3e8545.gif[/img]
Hi, Speedrunners! 
Today we are proud to announce [b]"The Drunk Side of the Moon"[/b], the first DLC Expansion for SEUM. It brings a ton of new content to the original game including 3 new powerups, 33 new levels, and new speedrun mutators! 
https://youtu.be/6G7KptTt1dw
[h1]What's on the Drunk side of the Moon? [/h1]
[list]
    [*][h1]Roar[/h1]
(New Powerup!): Point and fly, super-fast way to fly through levels. It feels like guiding a Redeemer on steroids.
    [*][h1]Rocket[/h1]
(New Powerup!): Now you can rocket jump, and it’s fun. But we haven’t stopped there! You can actually jump on the rocket and ride it! Going too slow? No problem shoot the rocket with a fireball to give it an extra boost.
    [*][h1]Shadow World [/h1]
(New Powerup!): Explore specially crafted levels from the two viewpoints: the world of light and the world of shadows.
[*][h1]Speedrun mutators[/h1]
Speedrun mode now has mutators which allow you to play speedrun mode by having a powerup of your choosing when you start the level. Replay the old levels with completely new strategies.
[/list]

We also just released the new game update which marks the beginning of the [b]Season 4.[/b] 
To celebrate, the game will be [b]66.6% off[/b] from tomorrow (21st Oct), and you can get the new DLC Expansion now for just [b]5 bucks![/b] 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/457210
Hope you'll like the new content.  
Happy speedrunning! \m/ 

[i]-Pine Studio[/i]

notes.title: SEUM Level Editor Update is out!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24329565/9f7a5f2c027a29fac446ef033a0d403567f76ce8.jpg[/img]
The Level editor is the feature SEUM community has been longing for ever since the game came out. We are proud to announce that our free Level Editor Update is out and available in-game.

notes.title: SEUM update #03
notes.content:
Focus of this update is still mostly bug fixes. But, we also included [b]a little gift for you in the "Extras" section[/b]! ;)

[b]Speedrun mode:[/b]
[list]
    [*] Displaying correct time differences from the best run
    [*] Fixed problem with falling in level 82
    [*] Fixed an issue with extra time appearing on timer
    [*] Fixed an issue with needing to go through gate multiple times when failing to collect a beer
    [*] You can show leaderboards by pressing TAB
[/list]
[b]Endless mode:[/b]
[list]
    [*] You can't fall endlessly anymore
    [*] You can now shoot through power-taking forcefield
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added multiple missing sounds
[*] You should see your saved progress even in odd situations with bad Steam login
[*] Added a cover image for soundtrack
[*] Fov slider can now go higher than 90
[*] Added ability to change which screen the game is displayed on
[*] Updated to new version of Unity engine 5.4.0p1
[/list]

notes.title: SEUM update #02
notes.content:
We've added a new stats page in "Extras" section of the main menu which shows the total progress of the game, including all bonuses.
 
We fixed a few things in the game as well: 
[list]
[*] Made score uploading more robust
[*] Full game speedrun now unlocks
[*] All achievements should now work correctly (666%, Beat a friend, Hardcore Runner)
[/list]
Happy SEUMing!

notes.title: SEUM update #01
notes.content:
The devs are listening and we are more than happy that you are not reporting too many bugs! :)
We fixed a few things in the game: 
[list]
 [*]Fixed timings on some levels
 [*]Added support for binding more mouse buttons
 [*]Fixed problems with control bindings resetting
 [*]Fixed endless mode shooting bug
 [*]Fixed restart bug in hardcore speedrun mode
[/list]
[b]SEUM Demo[/b] was still in beta version and today we updated it to the current state of the game. Check it out and try 11 levels for free!
